# Cava Audio Visualizer Configuration Template
# Optimized for smooth and responsive visualization

[general]
# Number of bars (20-200) - fewer bars = better performance
bars = 64
# Framerate (1-144) - higher = smoother but more CPU intensive
framerate = 60

[input]
# Audio input method: pulse, alsa, fifo, or portaudio
method = pulse
# Audio device (leave as default for auto-detection)
source = auto

[output]
# Output method: ncurses, terminal, raw, or circle
method = ncurses
# Terminal color scheme
style = stereo

[color]
# Color gradient for bars using template variables
gradient = 1
gradient_count = 8
gradient_color_1 = '#0076aa'
gradient_color_2 = '#5a63a6'
gradient_color_3 = '#706ed3'
gradient_color_4 = '#666cb6'
gradient_color_5 = '#5a3ad7'
gradient_color_6 = '#765ed6'
gradient_color_7 = '#661ae0'
gradient_color_8 = '#9331d5'

[smoothing]
# Noise reduction (0-100) - higher = smoother but less responsive
# 77 is default, 85 provides good balance for smooth visualization
noise_reduction = 85

# Monstercat smoothing (0 or 1) - adds smoothing between adjacent bars
monstercat = 1

# Wave effect (0 or 1) - creates wave-like motion across bars
waves = 0

# Gravity (0-200) - controls how fast bars fall
# 100 = normal gravity, 150 = faster fall, 50 = slower fall
gravity = 120

[eq]
# Equalizer settings for frequency response
# Lower frequencies tend to be louder, so reduce them slightly
1 = 0.8
2 = 0.9
3 = 1.0
4 = 1.1
5 = 1.2

files.XDG_CONFIG_HOME/satty/config.toml:
# Satty -- generated by `burl scheme' (theme.py apply_satty). Do not edit;
# edits are overwritten on the next wallpaper change.
#
# Only the annotation PALETTE is themed here. Satty's chrome is GTK-4 +
# libadwaita, so it is already themed by the gtk.css Guix deploys at
# ~/.config/gtk-4.0/gtk.css from this same scheme -- that is the reason satty
# replaced swappy rather than flameshot, which is Qt and would have ignored it.

[general]
# Annotate the region the burl picker already cropped, so no second crop step
# and no fullscreen overlay fighting the layershell picker for focus.
fullscreen = false
floating-hack = true
# Without this satty sizes its window to the IMAGE. A grab off DP-2 is
# 3840x2160, so opening it lands a 3840-wide floating window on the 2560-wide
# DP-3 and the toolbars hang off both edges. "smart" fits the window to the
# display it opens on instead.
resize = { mode = "smart" }
# The picker and burl-screenshot both wl-copy the shot BEFORE handing it over,
# so satty opening is already a "the shot is on the clipboard" state. Enter
# re-copies with the annotations on it; Escape drops them.
actions-on-enter = ["save-to-clipboard", "exit"]
actions-on-escape = ["exit"]
copy-command = "wl-copy"

# Ctrl+S lands in the burl saved-screenshots directory under the SAME bare
# timestamp convention services/Screenshots.qml parses
# (/^(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})$/ on the basename), so an
# annotated shot appears in the history card flagged saved, exactly like one
# the notification's Save action moved there.
output-filename = "~/Pictures/Screenshots/%Y%m%d%H%M%S.png"
save-after-copy = false

initial-tool = "brush"
default-hide-toolbars = false
primary-highlighter = "block"
# Matches the shell's own corner treatment rather than drawing square boxes
# over a rounded-everything desktop.
corner-roundness = 12
annotation-size-factor = 2
brush-smooth-history-size = 10
no-window-decoration = true

[font]
# The burl sans (packages/fonts.scm font-rubik), same face the shell uses.
family = "Rubik"
style = "Regular"

[color-palette]
# Ordered for the 1-9 number-key shortcuts, most-reached-for first. These are
# the SATURATED accent tokens, not the surface tones: an annotation is drawn on
# top of arbitrary screenshot content, so it has to stay legible against
# anything, which the low-chroma surface/outline colours do not.
#
# One token per HUE, deliberately. $yellow is omitted because these schemes
# derive it from the same wallpaper accent as $primary and the two come out
# byte-identical often enough (ef-melissa: both #e4b53f) to burn a number key
# on a duplicate. Likewise only one of the blue-ish trio $teal/$sapphire/$blue.
palette = [
    "#655789ff",
    "#8100c9ff",
    "#ad3fe1ff",
    "#0076aaff",
    "#5a3ad7ff",
    "#661ae0ff",
    "#9862dbff",
    "#34313aff",
]

# Presets in the full colour picker: the scheme's structural tones, for when an
# annotation should recede into the shot rather than shout over it.
custom = [
    "#fdf7feff",
    "#34313aff",
    "#7d7983ff",
    "#625c71ff",
    "#7b5270ff",
]

# Cava Audio Visualizer Configuration Template
# Optimized for smooth and responsive visualization

[general]
# Number of bars (20-200) - fewer bars = better performance
bars = 64
# Framerate (1-144) - higher = smoother but more CPU intensive
framerate = 60

[input]
# Audio input method: pulse, alsa, fifo, or portaudio
method = pulse
# Audio device (leave as default for auto-detection)
source = auto

[output]
# Output method: ncurses, terminal, raw, or circle
method = ncurses
# Terminal color scheme
style = stereo

[color]
# Color gradient for bars using template variables
gradient = 1
gradient_count = 8
gradient_color_1 = '#c8e3ff'
gradient_color_2 = '#d9deff'
gradient_color_3 = '#d6d8ff'
gradient_color_4 = '#c1c2ff'
gradient_color_5 = '#bdb4ff'
gradient_color_6 = '#d0c5ff'
gradient_color_7 = '#cbb4ff'
gradient_color_8 = '#d2b3e8'

[smoothing]
# Noise reduction (0-100) - higher = smoother but less responsive
# 77 is default, 85 provides good balance for smooth visualization
noise_reduction = 85

# Monstercat smoothing (0 or 1) - adds smoothing between adjacent bars
monstercat = 1

# Wave effect (0 or 1) - creates wave-like motion across bars
waves = 0

# Gravity (0-200) - controls how fast bars fall
# 100 = normal gravity, 150 = faster fall, 50 = slower fall
gravity = 120

[eq]
# Equalizer settings for frequency response
# Lower frequencies tend to be louder, so reduce them slightly
1 = 0.8
2 = 0.9
3 = 1.0
4 = 1.1
5 = 1.2

# Satty -- generated by `burl scheme' (theme.py apply_satty). Do not edit;
# edits are overwritten on the next wallpaper change.
#
# Only the annotation PALETTE is themed here. Satty's chrome is GTK-4 +
# libadwaita, so it is already themed by the gtk.css Guix deploys at
# ~/.config/gtk-4.0/gtk.css from this same scheme -- that is the reason satty
# replaced swappy rather than flameshot, which is Qt and would have ignored it.

[general]
# Annotate the region the burl picker already cropped, so no second crop step
# and no fullscreen overlay fighting the layershell picker for focus.
fullscreen = false
floating-hack = true
# Without this satty sizes its window to the IMAGE. A grab off DP-2 is
# 3840x2160, so opening it lands a 3840-wide floating window on the 2560-wide
# DP-3 and the toolbars hang off both edges. "smart" fits the window to the
# display it opens on instead.
resize = { mode = "smart" }
# The picker and burl-screenshot both wl-copy the shot BEFORE handing it over,
# so satty opening is already a "the shot is on the clipboard" state. Enter
# re-copies with the annotations on it; Escape drops them.
actions-on-enter = ["save-to-clipboard", "exit"]
actions-on-escape = ["exit"]
copy-command = "wl-copy"

# Ctrl+S lands in the burl saved-screenshots directory under the SAME bare
# timestamp convention services/Screenshots.qml parses
# (/^(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})$/ on the basename), so an
# annotated shot appears in the history card flagged saved, exactly like one
# the notification's Save action moved there.
output-filename = "~/Pictures/Screenshots/%Y%m%d%H%M%S.png"
save-after-copy = false

initial-tool = "brush"
default-hide-toolbars = false
primary-highlighter = "block"
# Matches the shell's own corner treatment rather than drawing square boxes
# over a rounded-everything desktop.
corner-roundness = 12
annotation-size-factor = 2
brush-smooth-history-size = 10
no-window-decoration = true

[font]
# The burl sans (packages/fonts.scm font-rubik), same face the shell uses.
family = "Rubik"
style = "Regular"

[color-palette]
# Ordered for the 1-9 number-key shortcuts, most-reached-for first. These are
# the SATURATED accent tokens, not the surface tones: an annotation is drawn on
# top of arbitrary screenshot content, so it has to stay legible against
# anything, which the low-chroma surface/outline colours do not.
#
# One token per HUE, deliberately. $yellow is omitted because these schemes
# derive it from the same wallpaper accent as $primary and the two come out
# byte-identical often enough (ef-melissa: both #e4b53f) to burn a number key
# on a duplicate. Likewise only one of the blue-ish trio $teal/$sapphire/$blue.
palette = [
    "#cdc0ecff",
    "#cfa1f6ff",
    "#e9c0f3ff",
    "#c8e3ffff",
    "#bdb4ffff",
    "#cbb4ffff",
    "#e9d5ffff",
    "#eae3efff",
]

# Presets in the full colour picker: the scheme's structural tones, for when an
# annotation should recede into the shot rather than shout over it.
custom = [
    "#030305ff",
    "#eae3efff",
    "#78737eff",
    "#cbc2dbff",
    "#ffcfefff",
]
files.XDG_CONFIG_HOME/spicetify/Themes/burl/co:
[burl]
text                = eae3ef                  ; Main text colour
subtext             = aea9b4           ; Subtext colour
main                = 07060a           ; Panel backgrounds
highlight           = cdc0ec                    ; Doesn't seem to do anything
misc                = cdc0ec                    ; Doesn't seem to do anything
notification        = 78737e                    ; Notifications probably
notification-error  = f97386                      ; Error notifications probably
shadow              = 000000                     ; Shadow for covers, context menu, also affects playlist/artist banners
card                = 0a080d       ; Context menu and tooltips
player              = 3e384c         ; Background for top result in search
sidebar             = 030305                    ; Background
main-elevated       = 0a080d       ; Higher layers than main, e.g. search bar
highlight-elevated  = 0c0a10    ; Home button and search bar accelerator
selected-row        = eae3ef                  ; Selections, hover, other coloured text and slider background
button              = cdc0ec                    ; Slider and text buttons
button-active       = cdc0ec                    ; Background buttons
button-disabled     = 78737e                    ; Disabled buttons
tab-active          = 0a080d       ; Profile fallbacks in search
---
name: 'Burl Theme'
accent: '#cdc0ec'
background: '#030305'
foreground: '#eae3ef'
details: darker

    black: '#080808'
    red: '#c365ff'
    green: '#ffbac2'
    yellow: '#ffdcf2'
    blue: '#a1a7d8'
    magenta: '#c09be5'
    cyan: '#9dceff'
    white: '#e8d3de'
  bright:
    black: '#ac9fa9'
    red: '#d48bff'
